Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 13

“The fourfold order was created by me according to distinctions of quality and function. Though I am its author, know me to be the unchanging non-doer.”

Krishna grounds social division in guna and karma — temperament and work — rather than in birth. Then he immediately steps back from authorship in the same breath.
